0.name: Narration
0.text: Neon rain falls over the Underdistrict. You are Cipher: a courier with a dangerous job tonight.

1.name: Kael
1.text: You're late. Got the guts for this run, or are you gonna freeze again?

2.name: Vira
2.text: NexCorp tightened security. We need a clean entry, no fireworks.

3.name: You
3.text: Who do you trust to get you in?

4.name: Kael
4.text: I'll short out their sensors. You just move when I say.

5.name: Vira
5.text: Follow my pathing exactly. One misstep and we fry.

6.name: Narration
6.text: You decide to slip in solo, trusting your instincts.

7.name: Narration
7.text: Inside NexCorp's outer perimeter, drones buzz overhead.

8.name: Narration
8.text: You spot the data terminal. The chip's within reach.

11.name: Narration
11.text: You boot your cyberdeck, running bypass scripts.

12.name: Narration
12.text: The systems blink out. Smooth as synth-butter.

13.name: Narration
13.text: Your hack triggers an alarm. Time to improvise.

14.name: Narration
14.text: You slip through shadows, barely avoiding patrols.

15.name: Narration
15.text: You snag the chip. Data pulses in your palm.

16.name: Kael
16.text: Got it? Good. Get out. Fast.

17.name: Narration
17.text: You sprint into the night, chip secured.

22.name: Narration
22.text: The Client was bait. NexCorp drones flood the room.

26.name: Narration
26.text: You're wounded. Vira drags you out under fire.

27.name: Narration
27.text: You plug into the net, scrambling the drones.

29.name: Narration
29.text: Your hack backfires. More drones join the fight.

30.name: Narration
30.text: You bolt into the streets, alone. The others barely keep up.

31.name: Narration
31.text: You regroup in an alley. The chip hums with encrypted power.

32.name: Kael
32.text: Whatever's on that chip... it's not just blackmail data.

33.name: Vira
33.text: It’s worse. I recognize the encryption signature.

36.name: Vira
36.text: I know NexCorp architecture. I’ll take point.

37.name: Narration
37.text: You route a call through the darknet. A masked figure answers.

38.name: Narration
38.text: You jack in, cracking the encrypted layers...

39.name: Zero
39.text: Zero here. Upload the fragment. Fast.

40.name: Narration
40.text: Bit by bit, the secrets of the chip unfold.

41.name: Narration
41.text: It’s not a bribe file. It's **Project Echelon** AI tech designed to control human thought.

42.name: Kael
42.text: They could make people slaves... without them even knowing.

43.name: Vira
43.text: We have to stop this. Before Solas activates Echelon.

45.name: Kael
45.text: Smart. Light a fire under the whole city.

46.name: Vira
46.text: We erase it. Wipe them clean.

47.name: Narration
47.text: You prepare a deal with NexCorp's dark ops division.

48.name: Narration
48.text: You approach the Underdistrict hub. It's time to end this...

50.name: Wisp
50.text: Got a message. You’re not alone in this fight.

51.name: Narration
51.text: Wisp hands you a datashard You have the rebels and my support...

52.name: Narration
52.text: But NexCorp forces are closing fast.

55.name: Narration
55.text: You jack into the Nexus grid, ready to fry the system.

56.name: Narration
56.text: Inside NexCorp's heart, Director Solas waits.

57.name: Director Solas
57.text: You're too late. Humanity needs order! Not chaos...

63.name: Narration
63.text: Your alliances shaped the city's fate. The path ahead reveals your legacy.

64.name: Freedom Requiem
64.text: The lights of NexCorp blink out, one tower at a time. In the distance, a neon dawn rises over a city finally free.

65.name: Ghost in the Circuit
65.text: You vanish into the net, leaving your old life behind. Power hums at your fingertips. Was it worth the cost?

66.name: City of Chains
66.text: The city falls silent under NexCorp’s iron code. Thought, freedom, and rebellion...erased in a blink...

67.name: Narration
67.text: Years later, legends of the Courier spark whispered hope in the backstreets.

68.name: Narration
68.text: Some say Cipher fought for freedom.

69.name: Narration
69.text: Some say Cipher seized power in secret.

70.name: Narration
70.text: Others say Cipher fell, and NexCorp rules without challenge.

71.name: Narration
71.text: But the neon flickers. And rebellion...like light... never dies...

72.name: The End
72.text: Thank you for playing Neon Requiem.
